verdict.rationale: AMD provides an official SDK (ROCm) for the RX 9070 XT with documented support for major AI frameworks (PyTorch on Windows/Linux, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX) and inference stacks (vLLM full support, llama.cpp), giving AI-native developers a real path to build against official tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and concrete API/SDK reference docs (openapi probe returned 404s) that would confirm depth of developer-facing API surface.
